name: Crontinel
description: Monitors cron, queue, and Horizon jobs via HTTP outcome receipts that flag runs exiting 0 without doing work, and exposes job status and alerts to AI agents over an OAuth-gated MCP endpoint.

skills.name: Scheduled Job Inventory
skills.description: Lists every monitored scheduled job through the list_scheduled_jobs tool so an agent can see what is under watch and how it is configured.

skills.name: Cron Run Status
skills.description: Reports the latest cron run state with get_cron_status, covering missed, late, and failed executions for a monitored schedule.

skills.name: Queue And Horizon Health
skills.description: Checks worker and backlog health using get_queue_status and get_horizon_status across Laravel Horizon and other queue backends.

skills.name: Alert Triage
skills.description: Reads open incidents with list_recent_alerts and clears them using acknowledge_alert so an agent can triage job failures in place.

skills.name: Alert Creation
skills.description: Opens a new alert through the create_alert tool when an agent detects a job problem outside the monitor own scheduled checks.

skills.name: Run Outcome Ingest
skills.description: Posts run outcomes to the /api/v1/ingest cron, schedule, event, and ping endpoints with an API key to record what a job actually did.
